title: Príncipe Real — 3-bedroom garden apartment with Tagus views
description: A rare garden-floor apartment on Rua Dom Pedro V, steps from Praça do Príncipe Real. Fully renovated in 2023 with oak flooring, a Bulthaup kitchen and floor-to-ceiling windows opening onto a private 42 m² terrace. The building dates from 1912 with a restored façade; inside, three double bedrooms (one en-suite), two bathrooms and a separate laundry. Ideal as a primary residence or high-yield short-let in one of Lisbon's most sought-after districts. Annual IMI approx. €2,400. Energy certificate B-.
address: 84 Rua Dom Pedro V, Príncipe Real, 1250-142 Lisbon

title: Ribeira townhouse — 4-bed riverside home, UNESCO quarter
description: Characterful four-bedroom townhouse on Rua de São João, 200 m from the Douro waterfront. Spread over four floors with a rooftop terrace overlooking the Dom Luís I bridge. Original granite walls, chestnut beams and a contemporary extension (2021) housing the kitchen and master suite. Two living rooms, a wine cellar and a single garage space included. Strong long-let demand from expat families; short-let licence transferable. Freehold, no condominium fees.
address: 17 Rua de São João, Ribeira, 4050-553 Porto

title: Vilamoura — Pool villa, marina lifestyle, Algarve
description: Contemporary four-bedroom villa in a gated community 400 m from Vilamoura Marina. 320 m² living space on a 1,100 m² plot with heated pool, landscaped gardens and outdoor kitchen. Open-plan ground floor, cinema room and a master suite with dressing room. Golf course views; five championship courses within 15 minutes. Ideal lock-and-leave second home with strong summer rental demand. Annual condominium €2,400.

title: Alfama — 2-bed short-let apartment with castle views
description: Turn-key two-bedroom apartment on Rua de São Tomé, in the heart of Alfama with a direct view of São Jorge Castle from the living room. Renovated in 2022 keeping the original azulejo panels and pine ceilings; new plumbing, electrics and ducted air conditioning throughout. Registered AL (short-let) licence included in the sale — 2025 occupancy averaged 84% at €142/night. Sold furnished and equipped, ready to operate from day one. Energy certificate C.
address: 23 Rua de São Tomé, Alfama, 1100-563 Lisbon

title: Chiado — 1-bed pied-à-terre on Rua Garrett
description: Elegant one-bedroom apartment on the third floor of a Pombaline building on Rua Garrett, above the historic cafés of Chiado. 55 m² with 3 m ceilings, restored wooden floors and a Juliet balcony over the street. Compact fitted kitchen, marble bathroom and a quiet bedroom to the rear courtyard. Lift in the building — rare for the district. Strong furnished long-let demand from digital professionals at €1,600–1,800/month. Condominium €65/month.

title: Foz do Douro — 3-bed ocean-view apartment, Avenida do Brasil
description: Front-line three-bedroom apartment on Avenida do Brasil with uninterrupted Atlantic views from a 24 m² terrace. 128 m² recently refurbished: Krion kitchen worktops, underfloor heating in bathrooms and electric blinds throughout. Master suite with walk-in wardrobe plus two further doubles. Two parking spaces and a storage room in the building. Foz is Porto's most consistent prime micro-market — sea-facing stock rarely trades. Condominium €120/month, energy certificate B.
address: 210 Avenida do Brasil, Foz do Douro, 4150-153 Porto

title: Cascais — 4-bed villa with pool near Quinta da Marinha
description: Single-storey villa of 240 m² on a 950 m² walled plot between Cascais town and the Quinta da Marinha golf resort. Four bedrooms (two en-suite), a 55 m² living room opening to the pool terrace, and a self-contained guest annex. Renovated 2023: new roof insulation, heat-pump climate control, solar hot water and EV charging. Ten minutes' walk to international schools; 25 minutes to Lisbon airport. Guincho beach 5 minutes by car. Energy certificate A.
address: Rua da Areia 14, Quinta da Marinha, 2750-053 Cascais

title: Lagos — Renovated 3-bed townhouse, old town
description: Traditional townhouse on Rua Cândido dos Reis, fully renovated in 2021 behind its original façade. Three bedrooms over two upper floors, a ground-floor living/kitchen space with exposed stone, and a 30 m² roof terrace with sea glimpses over the old town. Walking distance to the marina and Meia Praia. Currently operated as a licensed holiday let — 2025 gross income €41,000 with local management in place, transferable to the buyer. No condominium fees; freehold.

title: Funchal, Madeira — 2-bed apartment with sea-view terrace
description: South-facing two-bedroom apartment in a 2018 residence above Funchal's Lido promenade. 95 m² interior plus a 20 m² terrace looking straight down the Atlantic coastline. Open-plan living with a fitted Nolte kitchen, two double bedrooms and two bathrooms. Residence amenities: outdoor pool, gym and one garage space. Madeira's digital-nomad inflow keeps furnished long-let demand strong year-round — estimate €1,500/month. Condominium €95/month, energy certificate B.

title: Braga — High-yield 3-bed apartment near the university
description: Bright third-floor apartment on Rua do Bonjardim corridor pricing at a fraction of Lisbon levels. 110 m² with three bedrooms, a refreshed kitchen (2024) and a balcony over a quiet courtyard. Braga combines Portugal's youngest population with a growing tech employment base (Bosch, Fujitsu), keeping vacancy near zero. Currently let to postgraduate tenants at €1,150/month — 5.6% gross yield with clear reversion upside. Lift, storage room and one parking space included.
address: 45 Rua do Taxa, São Vicente, 4710-448 Braga

title: Dubai Marina — 2-bed with full marina view, Marina Walk
description: Fully furnished two-bedroom apartment in a premium tower on Marina Walk with unobstructed marina and yacht-club views. 1,285 sq ft, open kitchen with Bosch appliances, floor-to-ceiling glazing and a 90 sq ft balcony. Building amenities: infinity pool, gym, concierge and covered parking (1 bay). Tenanted until March 2027 at AED 145,000/year — 5.1% gross yield. Service charge AED 18/sq ft. Freehold for all nationalities.

title: Business Bay — 1-bed canal view, Marasi Drive
description: High-floor one-bedroom apartment on Marasi Drive overlooking the Dubai Water Canal. 775 sq ft with a fitted open kitchen, built-in wardrobes and a glazed balcony facing the Burj Khalifa skyline at night. Handover 2022; building offers a lap pool, sauna, co-working lounge and 24/7 security. Vacant on transfer — comparable units achieve AED 95,000–105,000/year, an estimated 6.9% gross yield. Service charge AED 16/sq ft. Freehold.

title: JVC — High-yield studio in District 13
description: Efficient 452 sq ft studio in a 2021-handover building in Jumeirah Village Circle, District 13. Fully fitted kitchen, floor-to-ceiling windows and a balcony over the community park. JVC remains Dubai's strongest yield district: this unit is tenanted at AED 52,000/year — 8.4% gross on asking price. Building has a pool, gym and retail at ground level; one covered parking bay included. Service charge AED 12/sq ft. Ideal first Dubai acquisition or portfolio yield-booster.

title: Downtown Dubai — 2-bed with Burj Khalifa view
description: Corner two-bedroom apartment on a high floor of a flagship Downtown tower, with a direct Burj Khalifa and fountain view from the living room and both bedrooms. 1,290 sq ft, upgraded kitchen with Miele appliances, powder room and utility. Residents enjoy an infinity pool deck, spa, squash court and valet. Two minutes' walk to Dubai Mall metro link. Vacant and ready to move in or let — rental estimate AED 220,000/year. Service charge AED 22/sq ft. Freehold.
address: Mohammed Bin Rashid Boulevard, Downtown Dubai

title: Palm Jumeirah — 3-bed shoreline apartment, private beach
description: Rare three-bedroom apartment in a Shoreline residence on the trunk of Palm Jumeirah, with direct access to a residents-only private beach. 2,050 sq ft: sea-facing living room, three en-suite bedrooms, maid's room and a wraparound terrace at sunset orientation. Fully renovated 2024 with herringbone oak floors and a bespoke kitchen. Building amenities include beach club, pools, gym and covered parking (2 bays). Strong premium short-let potential — comparable units gross AED 450,000+/year. Freehold.

title: Dubai Hills Estate — 3-bed townhouse on the park
description: Modern three-bedroom townhouse in a family cluster of Dubai Hills Estate, backing directly onto the central park loop. 2,260 sq ft over two floors: open living/dining, fitted kitchen, three bedrooms plus maid's room, and a landscaped private garden. Community offers the Dubai Hills Mall, golf course, schools and clinics within the master plan. Tenanted at AED 195,000/year until January 2027 — 6.1% gross. Two covered parking bays. Service charge approx. AED 3.5/sq ft on plot.

title: Dubai Creek Harbour — 1-bed with creek skyline view
description: One-bedroom apartment in a 2023-handover tower at Dubai Creek Harbour, the emirate's next waterfront centre. 730 sq ft with a full-width balcony framing the creek and the Downtown skyline beyond. Fitted kitchen with integrated appliances, floor-to-ceiling glazing and smart-home controls. Podium level offers pools, gym, BBQ decks and a residents' lounge. Early-cycle pricing relative to Downtown: rental estimate AED 90,000/year — 6.7% gross. One parking bay; freehold for all nationalities.
address: Creek Beach District, Dubai Creek Harbour, Dubai

title: Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi — 2-bed near the Louvre
description: Two-bedroom apartment in a beachside residence on Saadiyat Island, ten minutes from the Louvre Abu Dhabi and the upcoming Guggenheim. 1,240 sq ft with a family-sized living room, two en-suite bedrooms and a balcony over landscaped gardens toward the sea. Residence includes beach access, pools, tennis and a kids' club. Saadiyat's cultural-district build-out continues to support values; rental estimate AED 140,000/year. Two parking bays and storage included. Freehold zone.
address: Saadiyat Beach Residences, Saadiyat Island, Abu Dhabi

title: Dubai Marina — Duplex penthouse with 360° views
description: Signature duplex penthouse crowning a Marina tower: 2,800 sq ft over two levels with 360-degree views across the marina, Palm Jumeirah and the open Gulf. Double-height reception, four en-suite bedrooms, show kitchen plus service kitchen, and a 400 sq ft terrace with plunge pool. Delivered fully upgraded: book-matched marble, Lutron lighting and a private lift lobby. Three parking bays, storage and access to the tower's spa floor. A trophy asset in Dubai's most liquid prime district.
address: King Salman Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud Street, Dubai Marina

title: Le Marais — Haussmannian 2-bed near Place des Vosges
description: Elegant second-floor apartment in a 1870 limestone building on Rue des Archives. Original herringbone parquet, marble fireplaces and 3.1 m ceiling height. Two bedrooms (12 m² and 14 m²), a galley kitchen upgraded with Miele appliances, and a combined living/dining room of 32 m². Cellar included. Charges de copropriété €420/month. Stone's throw from Place des Vosges, Musée Picasso and Saint-Paul Métro (Line 1). Ideal pied-à-terre or long-let to corporate tenants.
address: 28 Rue des Archives, Le Marais, 75004 Paris

title: Presqu'île — Lyon 3-bed with Rhône views
description: Spacious third-floor apartment overlooking the Rhône on Quai Rambaud. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a 38 m² living room with balcony. Recently insulated façade (2024), double glazing and individual gas heating. Underground parking space included. Five minutes to Place Bellecour and Part-Dieu TGV. Rental estimate €2,100/month unfurnished. Copropriété charges €310/month.

title: Saint-Germain-des-Prés — 3-bed on Rue Bonaparte
description: Fourth-floor apartment with lift on Rue Bonaparte, between the Seine and Place Saint-Sulpice. 115 m² of classic Rive Gauche proportions: enfilade reception with three windows over the street, three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a separate eat-in kitchen. Restored mouldings, point-de-Hongrie parquet and two marble fireplaces. Cellar and bicycle room. Charges €540/month. One of the most defensively priced micro-markets in Europe — Saint-Germain stock trades within days.

title: Montmartre — 1-bed with Sacré-Cœur glimpse, Rue Lepic
description: Charming one-bedroom apartment on the fifth floor (no lift) of a 1900 building on Rue Lepic, in the village heart of Montmartre. 42 m² cleverly arranged: living room with open kitchen, a quiet bedroom on the courtyard and a renovated shower room. Exposed beams and a working fireplace; a glimpse of the Sacré-Cœur dome from the kitchen window. Charges €95/month. Strong furnished-let demand — estimate €1,450/month. Compact entry into central Paris under €550k.

title: Promenade des Anglais — Sea-facing 2-bed, Nice
description: Front-line two-bedroom apartment on the Promenade des Anglais with the Baie des Anges filling every window. 85 m² on the sixth floor of a classic 1930s palais with concierge: double living room opening to a sea-facing loggia, two bedrooms, renovated bathroom and a separate kitchen. Air conditioning, cellar and a lock-up garage (rare on the Promenade). Charges €380/month. Year-round short-let and winter-let demand; Nice airport 15 minutes.

title: Chartrons, Bordeaux — Stone townhouse with garden
description: Classic échoppe bordelaise in the Chartrons district, fully restored in 2022. 165 m² over two floors behind the original blonde-stone façade: double reception with 3.4 m ceilings, open kitchen onto a 60 m² south-facing garden, four bedrooms and two bathrooms. New roof, heat pump and fibre. Tram B two streets away; the Quais and Sunday market at the end of the road. Bordeaux's wine-trade quarter keeps family-let demand deep — estimate €2,400/month unfurnished.

title: Cannes — 2-bed steps from the Croisette
description: Renovated two-bedroom apartment in the Banane district, 150 m from the Croisette and the Palais des Festivals. 88 m² on the third floor with lift: south-facing living room and 12 m² terrace, two en-suite bedrooms, fitted kitchen and reversible air conditioning throughout. Sold with a private cellar; optional garage nearby. Charges €290/month. Congress-season corporate lets are the hidden yield story in Cannes — MIPIM and the Festival can gross a full month's rent per week.

title: Vieux-Port, Marseille — Converted loft with harbour light
description: Industrial-to-residential loft conversion two streets behind the Vieux-Port. 105 m² on one level: 4 m ceilings, steel-framed glazing, polished concrete floors and a sleeping mezzanine over the master suite. Second bedroom, bathroom and a home-office nook. Secure building with intercom and bike storage. Marseille's centre is re-rating fast on the back of the Euroméditerranée investment programme — this asset offers a 5.8% projected gross yield furnished. Charges €140/month.

title: Biarritz — 2-bed facing the Grande Plage
description: Second-floor apartment in a Belle Époque building directly opposite the Grande Plage and the Hôtel du Palais gardens. 80 m² with a bow-window living room framing the ocean, two bedrooms, renovated kitchen and bathroom (2023), and reversible heating. Cellar and shared bike/surfboard room. Charges €260/month. Biarritz combines resilient second-home demand with a growing year-round remote-work population; furnished seasonal lets gross €35,000–45,000 in a normal year.

title: Ruzafa — Loft apartment with private terrace, Valencia
description: Industrial loft conversion on Calle de Cuba in the heart of Ruzafa — Valencia's creative district. Open-plan 98 m² living space with 3.2 m ceilings, exposed brick and a mezzanine home office. South-facing terrace (18 m²) with outdoor kitchen. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms, ducted A/C and underfloor heating. Building has lift and bicycle storage. Walking distance to Mercado de Colón and Turia gardens. Current tenant until September 2026 at €1,450/month.

title: Pedregalejo — Beachfront villa with pool, Málaga
description: Detached four-bedroom villa 80 m from Pedregalejo beach on the eastern Costa del Sol. 280 m² built on a 520 m² plot with infinity pool, outdoor dining pergola and a separate guest studio. Panoramic sea views from the upper terrace. Renovated 2022: solar panels, heat pump and smart-home lighting. Double garage and gated entrance. Licenced holiday rental — 2025 gross income €68,000. IBI €1,850/year.

title: Salamanca, Madrid — Classic 2-bed on Calle de Serrano
description: Refined two-bedroom apartment on Calle de Serrano in the golden mile of Salamanca. 105 m² on the fourth floor of a doorman building: double-aspect living room, two en-suite bedrooms, herringbone oak floors and central climate control. Renovated 2023 to a turnkey standard. Community fees €310/month. Madrid prime continues to draw Latin American and domestic capital; Serrano addresses hold value through every cycle. Rental estimate €3,600/month furnished.

title: Eixample, Barcelona — Modernista 3-bed with gallery
description: Classic Eixample apartment on Carrer de Mallorca with original modernista details: mosaic (Nolla) floors, carved double doors and a glazed rear gallery over the block courtyard. 125 m²: three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a 30 m² salon and renovated kitchen. Lift, concierge and A/C. Two blocks from La Pedrera. Community fees €180/month. Tourist-licence restrictions keep supply tight, supporting long-let rents — estimate €2,700/month furnished.

title: Kensington — Victorian 2-bed flat, Cromwell Road
description: Bright two-bedroom flat on the second floor of a red-brick Victorian mansion block on Cromwell Road. 72 m² with a west-facing reception room, separate kitchen, master bedroom with built-in wardrobes and a second double bedroom. Share of freehold; annual service charge £3,200. Zone 1 transport — Gloucester Road and Earl's Court within 8 minutes' walk. EPC rating C. Chain-free sale; vacant possession available.

title: Ancoats, Manchester — 2-bed in converted cotton mill
description: Two-bedroom apartment in a Grade II listed cotton mill conversion on Henry Street, Ancoats — repeatedly ranked among the UK's best urban neighbourhoods. 75 m² with exposed brick, cast-iron columns, 3.5 m ceilings and new sash-style glazing. Open-plan living, two doubles and a modern bathroom. Secure parking space included. Let at £1,550/month until August 2026 — 6.5% gross yield. Service charge £2,100/year; 250-year lease from 2017.

title: Shoreditch — Warehouse loft on Curtain Road
description: Authentic warehouse loft on Curtain Road in the heart of Shoreditch. 88 m² of open-plan space with original timber floors, exposed services and steel windows across the full street elevation. One enclosed bedroom plus a study/second-bedroom mezzanine, and a bathroom finished in concrete and brass. Lift and video entry. Leasehold 120 years remaining; service charge £2,800/year. Five minutes to Old Street and Liverpool Street — deep corporate and creative tenant pool at £2,900/month.

title: Brera — Design-led 2-bed near Pinacoteca di Brera
description: Architect-renovated apartment on Via Brera, 150 m from the Pinacoteca. 105 m² with a 28 m² living room, designer kitchen (Boffi), two bedrooms and two bathrooms. Air conditioning, alarm system and video entry. Condominium fees €180/month. A-rated energy certificate. Strong demand from Milan's fashion and finance professionals; ideal furnished long-let at €3,200/month. No agent commission for direct buyers.

title: Trastevere, Rome — 2-bed with private roof terrace
description: Top-floor apartment on Via della Lungaretta in the cobbled heart of Trastevere, crowned by a private 35 m² roof terrace with views over the rooftops to the Gianicolo. 90 m²: beamed living room, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a kitchen opening onto the terrace stair. Renovated 2021 with new systems and A/C. Condominium €120/month. Short-let track record available — 2025 gross €52,000 — or a superb personal base in Rome's most loved rione.

title: Oltrarno, Florence — 2-bed near Ponte Vecchio
description: Second-floor apartment on Borgo San Frediano in the artisan quarter of Oltrarno, five minutes' walk from Ponte Vecchio. 85 m² with pietra serena details, restored terracotta floors and 3.2 m beamed ceilings. Two bedrooms, a renovated bathroom and a bright eat-in kitchen over the inner courtyard. Condominium €90/month. Florence caps new short-let licences in the UNESCO zone — existing registered status conveys with the sale, protecting a 2025 gross of €48,000.

title: Eaux-Vives, Geneva — Lake-view 3-bed on Rue Versonnex
description: Classic three-bedroom apartment on Rue Versonnex, one street back from Lake Geneva and the Jet d'Eau promenade. 140 m² on the fifth floor with lift: double reception with lake glimpses, three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony at morning sun. Building renovated 2019; cellar and one garage bay included. Charges CHF 620/month. Geneva's chronic supply shortage keeps vacancy under 0.5% — the definition of a capital-preservation asset, with stable CHF income.

title: Seefeld, Zurich — 2-bed by the lake promenade
description: Contemporary two-bedroom apartment on Seefeldstrasse in Zurich's most liveable quarter, three minutes from the lake promenade and Opernhaus. 95 m² with an open living/kitchen space, two bedrooms, bathroom plus guest WC, and a west-facing loggia. Minergie-renovated building (2020) with lift, cellar and one underground parking space. Charges CHF 480/month. Zurich vacancy sits near record lows; Seefeld stock lets within days at CHF 4,200/month.
